description: This file contains utility functions and workflows for uploading test artifacts, logs, and test reports to AWS S3, as well as functions for parsing XML test reports and manually uploading failure JSONs. It is part of a testing and CI/CD pipeline for a PyTorch project.

methods.name: get_s3_resource
methods.description: Returns a cached boto3 S3 client instance.

methods.name: zip_artifact
methods.description: Zips specified files into a single archive, paths relative to REPO_ROOT.

methods.name: concated_logs
methods.description: Concatenates all log files in the test-reports directory into a single string.

methods.name: upload_to_s3_artifacts
methods.description: Uploads test reports, logs, and JSONs to S3, and optionally uploads logs if failed.

methods.name: zip_and_upload_artifacts
methods.description: Uploads artifacts if failed or after 20 minutes since last upload.

methods.name: trigger_upload_test_stats_intermediate_workflow
methods.description: Triggers a GitHub Actions workflow to upload test stats.

methods.name: parse_xml_and_upload_json
methods.description: Parses XML test reports, converts to JSON, and uploads to S3 with locking.

methods.name: upload_adhoc_failure_json
methods.description: Manually uploads a JSON indicating a test failure due to missing XML.
